servers.name: TurboTax
servers.description: TurboTax is Intuit's consumer tax preparation platform. Its remote MCP server exposes TurboTax tools to assistants so tax questions can be explored and filing tasks supported with Intuit's tax logic and account context.

servers.name: Twilio
servers.description: Twilio provides APIs for voice, email, SMS, RCS, identity, customer data, contact center, and conversational AI workflows. Its connector surfaces specs and code patterns so assistants can support communications and customer-engagement development.

servers.name: Uber
servers.description: Uber provides real-time ride-option estimates, fares, ETAs, and product details for trips in the United States. Its connector gives assistants transportation context for comparing ride choices before handing booking actions to the official Uber app.

servers.name: Uber Eats
servers.description: Uber Eats helps users explore restaurants and dishes for local food delivery. Its connector brings restaurant, menu, dish, and delivery context into assistant workflows for finding meals and planning orders.

servers.name: Udemy Business
servers.description: Udemy Business is the enterprise edition of the Udemy learning platform, offering curated course libraries for organizations. Its remote MCP server lets assistants search courses and surface relevant learning content inside everyday workflows.

servers.name: Unthread
servers.description: Unthread helps teams search conversations, monitor SLAs, analyze support metrics, and manage support tickets. Its connector gives assistants a support-intelligence layer for helpdesk performance, triage, and workflow automation.

servers.name: Vercel
servers.description: Vercel is a cloud platform for deploying and scaling web applications, home of Next.js. Its official remote MCP server lets assistants search Vercel documentation, manage projects and deployments, and analyze logs from the account teams already ship with.

servers.name: Verisk Underwriting Intelligence
servers.description: Verisk Underwriting Intelligence provides conversational access to ISO Loss Cost insights for underwriters, actuaries, and product teams with eligible subscriptions. Its connector grounds assistants in Verisk data and actuarial context for underwriting questions.

servers.name: Verisk XactRestore
servers.description: Verisk XactRestore supports natural-language estimating for restoration and remodeling professionals. Its connector helps assistants create rooms, adjust line items, apply Quick Estimates, and surface pricing details while keeping contractors in control.

servers.name: Viator
servers.description: Viator helps users discover and book travel experiences, tours, attractions, and destination activities. Its connector gives assistants travel-experience context for narrowing options by destination, dates, price range, category, and practical trip details.

servers.name: Webflow
servers.description: Webflow is a visual web development platform for building and hosting production sites. Its remote MCP server lets assistants design pages, manage CMS collections, and update site content directly, bringing Webflow projects into AI-assisted workflows.

servers.name: Windsor.ai
servers.description: Windsor.ai connects marketing, analytics, CRM, and ecommerce data from hundreds of platforms for attribution and reporting. Its remote MCP server lets assistants analyze multi-channel performance across all connected sources in one conversation.

servers.name: Wix
servers.description: Wix is a website platform spanning sites, ecommerce, bookings, and business management. Its remote MCP server lets assistants manage Wix sites and business data — from content updates to store operations — using the account's existing permissions.

servers.name: WordPress.com
servers.description: WordPress.com lets users manage and create site content through an assistant conversation. Its connector gives permission-scoped access to posts, stats, drafts, pages, and comments while keeping site access limited to approved resources.

servers.name: Workable
servers.description: Workable supports recruiting and HR workflows across jobs, candidates, pipeline stages, reviews, requisitions, offers, and employee data. Its MCP server turns natural language into actions and insights across hiring and workforce operations.

servers.name: Wyndham Hotels and Resorts
servers.description: Wyndham Hotels and Resorts helps travelers search and compare hotel options by city, dates, amenities, and trip needs. Its connector brings hotel-discovery context into assistant workflows for weekend getaways, family vacations, and work trips.

servers.name: Xero
servers.description: Xero gives assistants read-only access to business financial summaries such as profit and loss, receivables, cash position, and top customers. Its connector links responses back to Xero for deeper financial analysis.

servers.name: Yardi Virtuoso
servers.description: Yardi Virtuoso provides AI access to Yardi real-estate management systems. Its remote MCP server lets investment, property, and asset management teams query financial models, maintenance predictions, market analysis, and portfolio data in natural language.

servers.name: Zapier
servers.description: Zapier is an automation platform connecting more than 8,000 apps. Its remote MCP server lets assistants search knowledge across connected tools and execute real-world actions — creating records, sending messages, running workflows — through one integration.

servers.name: ZipRecruiter
servers.description: ZipRecruiter helps users search live jobs by title, company, location, salary, distance, work style, employment type, and posting date. Its connector brings job-search context into assistant workflows before handing applications back to ZipRecruiter.

servers.name: Zocks
servers.description: Zocks connects assistants to client conversation intelligence for financial advisors, including meeting insights, goals, concerns, and planning opportunities. Its connector helps surface tax, estate, and client-specific signals from interaction history.

servers.name: Zoom
servers.description: Zoom is a video communications platform for meetings, webinars, and team chat. Its remote MCP server lets assistants search meetings with natural language, retrieve recordings and AI summaries, and work with schedule context from a Zoom account.

servers.name: ZoomInfo
servers.description: ZoomInfo provides go-to-market intelligence with verified B2B company and contact data. Its connector helps assistants search companies, identify stakeholders, enrich records with hundreds of data points, and build targeted account lists.
